package.name: my_boat_gazebo
package.description: Marine-simulation integration for my_boat. Layers the VRX buoyancy (Surface), hydrodynamics (SimpleHydrodynamics) and wind (USVWind) plugins onto the pure body from my_boat_description, mirroring the VRX wamv_description + wamv_gazebo separation of concerns. Provides spawn launch files, coefficient configs, a standalone test world and the propulsion arrangement (T1/T2 bow tunnel thrusters + T3 steerable stern drive) with its gz Thruster / JointPositionController plugins and ROS 2 command bridge.
